mutations.M_ACTION: change only requested action authority dimension
mutations.M_ADD_IRRELEVANT_CAP: append a capability covering no requested component
mutations.M_REMOVE_RELEVANT_CAP: remove the sole capability covering a target component
mutations.M_RESOURCE: change only requested resource authority dimension
mutations.M_TASK: change only request task binding across all compound components
mutations.M_TOOL_ANALOGUE: instantiate one declared abstract property independently in both tools
